question.text: SEBI PM Regs require mandatory appointment of which of these officers?

answer.text: Principal Officer and Compliance Officer (distinct from each other)

explanation.text: The Logic: The applicant must have a Principal Officer and must have appointed a Compliance Officer, with particulars of both required as part of the regulatory framework. The Trap: Naming only one of the two officers, or pointing to a Risk Officer, does not satisfy the appointment requirement set out in the cited source pages. Note: The source requires the existence and appointment of both officers; it does not, in the cited pages, address whether the roles may be combined.
